§ 225. Two adjectives may also be compounded into what is
called the विशेषणोभयपदकर्मधारयः as शुक्लकृष्णः, कृष्णसारंगः.

( a ). * Two participles expressive of two consecutive actions
of the same individual may be compounded together, the one
expressive of the previous action being placed first; आदौ स्नातः
पश्चादनुलिप्तः स्नातानुलिप्तः 'first bathed and then anointed';
similarly पीतोद्गीर्णश 'first drunk and afterwards vomited out'
पीतप्रतिबद्धः, पहीतप्रतिष्ठक: ( Rag. II. 1. IV. 43 ), &c.

( b ). In the case of the two sets of words given above
( § 222.g. ) forming compounds with one another those be-
ginning with पूर्व are placed first. In the case of एक compounded
with वीर it may precede or follow it; as वीरैक: or एकवीर:; the
former, however, is preferable. In the case of the first set of
words viz. एक......केवल the one succeeding precedes the one
preceding when compounded together; as पुराणनवत्, केवलपु-
राणम्, &c.

( c ) † A past participle is compounded with another with
the negative particle prefixed to it; 'कृताकृतम्,' what is done
and not done i. e. 'partially done'.
